categories.name: rpc
categories.evidence: Matches RPC/REST/ZMQ label and modifies JSON-RPC scanblocks handling in src/rpc/blockchain.cpp
categories.rationale: Fixes a critical RPC correctness bug where scanblocks silently returns incomplete match results with completed: true when block filters cannot be read. According to the PR description, 'The result is a silent gap: a caller gets a relevant_blocks list that looks fine but is missing any match in the unindexed range, with no way to distinguish "no matches" from "range was never scanned"', risking missed transactions and fund safety for consumers.
